summary: Frontend-only smoke + regression for Phase 1 module-split refactor (first slice) lifting red5OpenPopupWindow, Icon, Sparkline into /assets/js/dashboard/dashboard-helpers.js. Ran all 6 requested scenarios against live preview https://controller-dashboard-2.preview.emergentagent.com. 6/6 PASS. (1) Boot smoke: typeof Icon, Sparkline, red5OpenPopupWindow all resolve to 'function' in window scope after 7s wait; #root populated with 105k chars HTML; no Babel-error red banner; psychrometric chart, sidebar toolbar, G36 timeline strip all render (verified visually + via SVG counts). (2) Sidebar Icon usage: exactly 4 svg[viewBox='0 0 24 24'] elements inside <button> wrappers all carry inner <path>/<circle>/<rect> children (book-open, radio-tower, settings, rotate-ccw confirmed by tag inspection). Clicking the first icon button raises 0 new console errors. (3) Sparkline usage: direct React invocation with sample data [1..6..1] mounts an <svg> containing a <polyline points='0,18 8,14.8 16,11.6 24,8.4 32,5.2 40,2 48,5.2 56,8.4 64,11.6 72,14.8 80,18'/> (102 chars of point pairs) confirming the props-only component is fully functional. The DIAG-tab TRENDS panel correctly renders the documented 'no data' fallback because the simulator collector has not yet accumulated samples — this matches the explicit branch in dashboard-helpers.js:147. (4) POP OUT: /dashboard.html?modal_ahu=AHU-01-E exposes [data-testid='popout-ahu-modal-btn'] (63x18px, visible). Listening on page.context.on('page'), clicking spawned a new Playwright page (pages_before=1, after=2; event fired once); zero console errors and zero pageerror events during click. red5OpenPopupWindow handler runs end-to-end. (5) Regression: /mobile correctly redirects to /mobile_mockup.html (final url); /ashrae_55.html and /ashrae_90_1.html both return 200; dashboard.html re-renders AHU-01-E by default; sidebar + 3D chart + G36 timeline strip + 3 AHU rows (AHU-01-E/02-S/03-W) all present. (6) Parity: dashboard.html md5 matches local except for one Cloudflare-injected tracking iframe line (diff shows ONLY the cf challenge-platform <script> appended before </body> — content is byte-identical otherwise). dashboard-helpers.js md5 575037e11c0c66cdd4753990ec7c29fd matches LOCAL EXACTLY between /app/frontend/public/js/dashboard/dashboard-helpers.js and the public /assets/js/dashboard/dashboard-helpers.js. content-type: application/javascript; charset=UTF-8.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.html still ~5700 lines after this slice — continue Phase 1B (AHU/VAV modal extraction with prop-interface design) to push it under the >700 line guideline.

Pre-existing background errors observed in console (401/404 on /api telemetry endpoints, Babel 'deoptimised styling' note for >500KB inline source). These are not caused by this iteration's refactor but are worth tracking separately.
